conceptual_statement: Texas does not use one uniform regulatory system across the Trust Hub Network. Contractor licensing is split by specialty and local jurisdiction; insurance has a strong state agency/company graph; mortgage research combines HMDA with state enforcement; movers require separate state and federal authority checks; investment-adviser research separates federal SEC/IARD geography from Texas state registration; and senior care spans both CMS certification and Texas HHSC licensing.

release_gate.rule: All six specialist /texas pages must return HTTP 200 as intended state intelligence pages, indexable and self-canonical, before Ask /texas is indexable. Any one specialist failure fails the gate. Do not weaken the gate. No Texas county routes.

intelligence_strip.grain: distinct TDLR business identities. Not a general-contractor count. Vendor is not a license.
agency NPN identities from TDI. Not person licenses. Appointment count is not quality.
HMDA 2025 applications for Texas property location. Not a license roster.
complete Texas household-goods mover denominator. TxDMV bulk roster SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED. Missing is not zero.
federal roster firms with a Texas principal office. Not Texas state-RIA registration.
Nursing Homes, Home Health, Hospice, Assisted Living, and HCSSA are different classes. Do not sum them.

what_makes_texas_different: Texas has no statewide general-contractor license. Specialty trades, plumbing, vendor/procurement, and later local evidence stay separate.
TDI exposes an unusually complete agency-to-company appointment graph. Appointment count is not quality. A complaint is not a violation.
Texas mortgage activity is visible through 2025 HMDA even though a live statewide mortgage-company bulk roster is not acquired.
Household-goods movers require separate Texas intrastate and federal interstate authority checks. A USDOT number is not interstate operating authority by itself.
Federal SEC/IARD geography is not Texas state-RIA registration. ERA is not an RIA. Broker-dealer is not an investment adviser.
Senior care requires both CMS certification and Texas HHSC licensing, plus TULIP search for some classes. HHSC is not CMS.

research_topics: SML enforcement orders with exact NMLS
hubs.source_summary: LenderTrustHub publishes 2025 HMDA for Texas property location, SML enforcement orders, and official homebuyer-program families. A complete live mortgage-company bulk roster is not acquired.
hubs.coverage_summary: HMDA is not a license roster. An NMLS ID is not current Texas authority by itself. Name-only SML orders are unsafe for adverse profile attach. Denial rate is not quality.
semantic_guardrails: NMLS ≠ current Texas authority by itself
verified_facts: HMDA 2025: 954,534 applications, 524,257 originations, 183,420 denials (19.22%). Purchase 575,355; refinance 259,652. 253 of 254 counties; Loving County absent in the committed extract is not zero activity.
SML enforcement: 3,981 orders; 2,493 exact-NMLS rows; 1,488 name-only rows unsafe for adverse profile attach.
Seven official Texas homebuyer program families. CFPB Texas mortgage complaints: 29,013. A complaint is not a violation.

research_topics: Form E liability and Form H&I cargo filings
hubs.source_summary: Texas intrastate household-goods authority is not federal interstate authority. MoveTrustHub documents official verification paths. The TxDMV HHG bulk roster is SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED.
hubs.coverage_summary: A USDOT number alone is not interstate operating authority. TxDMV authority is not FMCSA authority. A tow company is not a household-goods mover. Complete Texas mover denominator is UNKNOWN, not zero.
verified_facts: TxDMV household-goods bulk roster: SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED / OPEN_SEARCH_ONLY. Complete Texas mover denominator is UNKNOWN, not zero.
Official verification concepts include a TxDMV certificate, Form E liability filing, Form H&I cargo filing, and FMCSA interstate operating authority.
Do not manufacture a Texas mover count from federal overlays.
